a, b, n = map(int, input().split())
a_val = float(a)
b_val = float(b)
min_diff = 1e9
base_ratio = a_val / b_val
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    candidate_num = (a * i) // b
    ratio = float(candidate_num)
    diff1 = abs(ratio / i - base_ratio)
    diff2 = abs((ratio + 1.0) / i - base_ratio)
    if diff1 < min_diff or (diff1 == min_diff and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and candidate_num < best_num))):
        min_diff = diff1
        best_num = candidate_num
        best_den = i
    if diff2 < min_diff or (diff2 == min_diff and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and candidate_num + 1 < best_num))):
        min_diff = diff2
        best_num = candidate_num + 1
        best_den = i
    if candidate_num > 0:
        diff3 = abs((candidate_num - 1.0) / i - base_ratio)
        if diff3 < min_diff or (diff3 == min_diff and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and candidate_num - 1 < best_num))):
            min_diff = diff3
            best_num = candidate_num - 1
            best_den = i

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
